input: Hem the curtains in the spare bedroom

gold.taskDescription: The user wants to hem the curtains in their spare bedroom.

questions.title: How many curtain panels need to be hemmed?
questions.description: Determine the total number of individual panels to plan time and materials.

questions.title: How much length needs to be taken off?
questions.description: Find out the exact amount to be removed from the bottom of each panel.

questions.title: What fabric are the curtains made from?
questions.description: Identify the fabric type, as it affects the hemming method and tools needed.

questions.title: Will you sew by hand, machine, or use hem tape?
questions.description: Clarify the preferred hemming method to tailor the steps appropriately.

questions.title: Do you have a sewing machine or iron available?
questions.description: Confirm which tools are on hand to determine what needs to be sourced.

questions.title: Are the curtains already hung or taken down?
questions.description: Establish the current state of the curtains to determine the first action step.

questions.title: When do you need this task completed by?
questions.description: Understand the deadline or urgency to help prioritize and schedule the work.
